svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 05 / GARDEN
svg.desc: 15,221 GitHub contributions across 144 active days, 2025-10-19 to 2026-10-20. Each active date grows a plant. Exact contribution counts control its height, leaves and flowering, while the recorded months bring seasonal colors. Public repository languages shape the aggregate planting blend when supplied.

g.text: Actual counts grow stems and leaves; five contributions earn a bloom.
Observed repository blend: C++ 43% / Python 41% / TypeScript 7%
